subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling technical deep-dive across time zones
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacorp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:15:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call recap + next step: technical deep-dive

Thanks for the call earlier — good conversation. Quick recap from my side: NovaCorp is evaluating options to standardize inference across hosted and on-prem workloads (regulatory constraints in APAC for several clinics). Key priorities are predictable latency (p95 targets), cost per token, and an integration path for our model artifacts.

Next step: we'd like a technical deep-dive/demo with our infra and security folks included. Because the team is distributed (Boston, Dublin, Singapore), can you propose a rotating schedule that doesn't force the same people to join at midnight every week?

To help coordinate, here are the constraints:
- Boston (UTC-4): prefers mornings 8:00–11:00 local
- Dublin (UTC+1): prefers afternoons 13:00–17:00 local
- Singapore (UTC+8): prefers evenings 19:00–22:00 local

Would appreciate two or three rotating slot templates (e.g., week A: US morning / EU afternoon / APAC evening; week B: shift +3 hours) so we can trial for three weeks. Also confirm who from Redwood should lead the demo (prod+security).

I've attached a short summary of our discovery notes (discovery-notes.pdf).

Thanks — Samir

Samir Patel
Director, Platform Engineering | NovaCorp
samir.patel@novacorp.com
Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacorp.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 18:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next step: technical deep-dive

Samir — thanks for the clear constraints and the notes. Glad to see alignment on the evaluation priorities.

We can absolutely run a rotating 3-week cadence. Two quick templates from our side (all times shown in local team times):

Template A — Fixed-band rotation (minimal shift)
- Week 1: US morning 09:00–10:00 (Boston) / EU overlap 14:00–15:00 (Dublin) / APAC overlap 20:00–21:00 (Singapore)
- Week 2: US morning 08:30–09:30 / EU 14:30–15:30 / APAC 19:30–20:30
- Week 3: US morning 10:00–11:00 / EU 15:00–16:00 / APAC 21:00–22:00

Template B — Canary shift (rotates primary window)
- Week 1: Primary US-friendly (09:00 Boston) with security join via recording + live Q&A for EU/APAC
- Week 2: Primary EU-friendly (15:00 Dublin) with trimmed US summary call
- Week 3: Primary APAC-friendly (20:30 Singapore) with recorded walkthrough + live office hours for US/EU

Operational asks from Redwood:
- Please confirm 3–4 attendees from NovaCorp you want on the live deep-dive (infra, security, data governance).
- Which template do you prefer to pilot for the first three cycles?
- Any calendar restrictions (blackout dates) in June/early July?

I can own the demo with Grace on security and Marissa covering integration details. If that works, I'll send a calendar poll (rotating windows) and an .ics export for each participant.

–Karthik

Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood-tech-reqs.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacorp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 19:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next step: technical deep-dive

Looping in a couple of security/ops notes so we don't get blocked:
- For hands-on demo access we typically ask for a temporary test dataset and a VPN jump host or bastion access pattern (we can demo without direct access, but some latency numbers will be estimates).
- We will include a short section on audit/logging (SOC2-like controls) and data residency options. If NovaCorp has a specific compliance checklist, please share ahead of the pilot.

Proposal: pick Template A to start for a 3-week trial. We'll run Week 1 live with full instrumentation, Week 2 live + recording, Week 3 recording + async Q&A. If we see major participant churn, we can switch to Template B.

Also attaching a short tech-req checklist (redwood-tech-reqs.docx) that lists ports, sample data size, and a minimal cert/key handshake.

Grace

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next step: technical deep-dive

Thanks — Template A looks good to us as a pilot. Quick answers:
- Attendees: myself (platform lead), Rajiv Menon (security lead, rajiv.menon@novacorp.com), and Mei Chen (data governance).
- Preferred first-week slot: Week 1 US morning 09:00 Boston slot works for our Singapore team if it's scheduled at 21:00 SGT. We'd rather not do recordings only for the first run; prefer live so security can ask clarifying Qs.
- Blackouts: none in early June; Rajiv is out 2027-06-10–2027-06-14.

Please send the calendar poll and add Rajiv. I've attached an .ics for our scheduling system (rotation-ics.ics).

Lina
